name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's motorsport journey began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the simulator. A keen eye for detail and an innate understanding of vehicle dynamics led him to excel in virtual racing. His talent was spotted by a Herberth Motorsport scout during an online competition, who recognized Dimitri's potential to translate his virtual expertise to real-world testing.

Now, as a Test Driver Coordinator, Dimitri bridges the gap between the engineering team and the drivers. He meticulously plans testing schedules, analyzes telemetry data, and provides crucial feedback to optimize performance. His pragmatic approach and uncanny ability to identify subtle nuances in vehicle behavior make him a valuable asset. Dimitri is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of performance through rigorous testing and data-driven insights.

Dimitri sets himself apart with his unwavering focus on precision and his ability to remain calm under pressure. He is known for his meticulous note-taking and his dedication to understanding every aspect of the car's performance. While he prefers to work independently, his dedication to the team's success is undeniable.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height, with a wiry build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even during lunch breaks.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of blue ink for all his notes.
